description:
Get a single Zindies creation (zine / publication) by token: its full
creator list, the shops that carry it (`places`, with address and geo
coordinates) and its online shop links (`online_links`). Use it to
answer "where can I buy this zine?". Needs the creation's `token`: when
the user gives a title, call search (type: "creation") first. For
everything one shop carries use get_place; for a creator's other works
use get_creator.

Each entry of `places` has:
- `carried_since`: when that shop added the zine to its shelf on
  Zindies (ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. "2026-10-03T14:30:00+09:00").
  It answers "since when does this shop carry it?"; it is not the
  zine's release date (`released_at`).
- `stock_status`: the shop's stock state, the same badge as on the web
  page, never a count: "in_stock", "low_stock" (only a few left),
  "out_of_stock", "new_release" (in stock and released within the last
  7 days), "upcoming" (the release date is still ahead) or "untracked"
  (the shop carries it but does not publish its stock; do not read it
  as out of stock). It reflects what the shop last entered, not a live
  inventory, so suggest confirming with the shop before a long trip.

`testimonials` are signed recommendations written by named
recommenders. When quoting one, always include its `attribution_text`,
keep the wording unchanged, and link to its `url` (the creation page;
its share preview shows the testimonial).

An unknown or non-public token returns an error result
(`isError: true`) with `error: "not_found"`.

locale.description: Response language for translatable text fields (names, titles, descriptions): ja = Japanese, en = English, ko = Korean, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese. Pass the language the user is conversing in when it is one of these; otherwise omit it. Fields without a translation fall back to their source language (usually Japanese), so one response can mix languages. Tokens, ids, dates and URLs are the same in every locale. Default: ja.

token.description: Public token of the creation: a short lowercase string such as "k3wd", taken as-is from the `token` field of a creation in search, get_creator (`creations[].token`) or get_place (`creations[].token`). Not the numeric `id` or the title. Exact match; an unknown or non-public token returns an error result with `error: "not_found"`.

name: get_creation
title: Get ZINE details
